method: Actual OpenSees uniform-load fixed-fixed beam; closed form at every sample plus independent consistent-load stiffness; 2/4 meshes, N-mm, half load

inputs.section_source: Explicit synthetic A and Iz; not actual project sections

limitations: 2D small-displacement linear Euler-Bernoulli elasticity only
No shear deformation, geometric stiffness, buckling, nonlinear or dynamic analysis
Rigid joints and fixed bases are explicit verification assumptions
No actual platform-wide mapping, foundation or connection capacity analysis
IS/US design checks and engineering approval disabled

independent_reference.formulation: Independent 2D EA/L and EI Euler-Bernoulli 6x6 stiffness, consistent uniform loads [qxL/2,qyL/2,qyL²/12,qxL/2,qyL/2,-qyL²/12], rigid-arm transformed assembly; Kff uf=Ff, R=Ku-F, end forces=k ulocal-fe

reference.formula: Fixed-fixed Euler-Bernoulli: Ry=-wL/2; Mi=-wL²/12, Mj=+wL²/12; v(x)=w x²(L-x)²/(24EI); V(x)=-wL/2+w x; M(x)=wL²/12-wLx/2+w x²/2
